- Unit economics: for the pilot we can target $1,600 / 1M tokens as a working number (this assumes a mixed workload: 70% chat completions on a 13B optimized model + 30% embeddings/regression). If you need more aggressive unit cost we can discuss quantized model variants or committed capacity discounts.
